description: russia-colonialism techniques used by NKVD National Operations and Institutional Russification (1937–1939), ATT&CK campaign C0080 (v1.2)
name: NKVD National Operations and Institutional Russification (1937–1939) (C0080)

techniques.comment: The conduct of secret mass "national operations" of the NKVD for the physical annihilation of members of ethnic minorities(Citation: В тени «Большого Брата»: Западные национальные меньшинства в СССР (1917-1938 гг.) 2011). The mechanism was set by the operational orders of people's commissar Yezhov: No. 00485 of 11 August 1937 opened the Polish operation - "to begin, from 20 August 1937, a broad operation aimed at the complete liquidation of the local organizations of the 'POW'" with completion "within a three-month term"(Citation: Оперативный приказ НКВД СССР № 00485 1937), - and No. 00439 of 25 July 1937 the German one(Citation: Оперативный приказ НКВД СССР № 00439 1937); the Greek, Bulgarian and other operations followed their template(Citation: В тени «Большого Брата»: Западные национальные меньшинства в СССР (1917-1938 гг.) 2011). The scale is recorded in the perpetrator's own accounting: according to the summary figures of the 1st Special Department of the NKVD of the Ukrainian SSR dated 30 August 1938, 94,659 people were arrested in the republic under orders Nos. 00485, 00593 and others (54,011 on the Polish line, 23,036 on the German, 5,642 on the Greek), of whom 61,683 had been convicted by 1 July 1938; in all, of the 197,945 people convicted by the NKVD of the Ukrainian SSR over the reporting period, 122,274 were sentenced to be shot - nearly two out of every three(Citation: Сводные данные об арестованных и осужденных органами НКВД УССР за время с 1 октября 1936 года по 1-е июля 1938 года 1938). Across all the "national lines" of the USSR, 335,513 people were convicted, and 73.66% of them were shot(Citation: Національне питання в Україні ХХ – початку ХХІ ст. 2012).

The forcible closure of all national councils, pedagogical institutes, theaters and cultural institutions of ethnic minorities in the Ukrainian SSR(Citation: Національно-культурне життя етнічних меншостей України ( 20-30-ті роки ): коренізація і денаціоналізація (1) 1998): the national districts and village soviets were liquidated by the resolution of the Orgburo of the Central Committee of the VKP(b) of 24 January 1938(Citation: О ликвидации национальных районов и сельсоветов 1938), and the resolution of the Politburo of the Central Committee of the KP(b)U of 10 April 1938 reorganized the national schools and colleges and turned the Odesa German Pedagogical Institute into an institute of foreign languages(Citation: Німці в Україні. 20—30-ті рр. XX ст. 1994).
